slice: PAR-134 SECTIONOBJECT CMC source-method retention and DXF loss guard

implementation.model: Append raw DWG CMC method; preserve through copy/assignment and clear on reset.
implementation.parser: Retain raw method with scalar, RGB, and optional names; clear DWG-only CMC provenance when a DXF scalar color group is parsed.
implementation.dwg_writer: Replay matching C0-C3; reject unsupported or inconsistent methods before common-prefix output.
implementation.dxf_writer: Refuse RGB/name/book companions before record output because documented SECTIONOBJECT DXF output is scalar group 63 only; do not invent group 411 mappings.
implementation.compatibility: Public DRW_SectionObject size changes; downstream consumers must rebuild. No virtual interface changed.

generated_controls.qualified_methods: Independently walk C0 ByLayer, C1 ByBlock, C3 ACI, and C2 RGB payloads.
generated_controls.unsupported_method: Mutate generated C3/ACI-7 to C5; verify parsed scalar/method, optional strings, following geometry/handles, copy/assignment/reset, and fail-before-output rewrite refusal.
generated_controls.dxf_loss_guard: ASCII/Binary writer refuses RGB, color-name, and color-book companion states before publishing output; scalar group-63 output remains supported.

validation.diff_check: PASS for src/drw_entities.cpp, src/drw_entities.h, src/libdxfrw.cpp, tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp, and tests/wave1_tests.cpp
